latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Idea Darwin Engine (Japanese version) — an iterative, evolution-inspired system for refining ideas.

- Adds a round-based idea evolution system: ideas are scored, fused, evolved, or flagged for user review in structured rounds.
- Supports commands for initialization, iteration, status, dormancy management, and summary display.
- File structure includes cards for each idea, round reports, leaderboards, and a relation graph.
- Implements a scoring framework with six axes and a three-layer calculation method to surface high-potential ideas and prevent stagnation.
- Includes configuration options for round budget, action limits, and periodic disruption via external stimuli.
- Provides detailed step-by-step flows for initialization and each iteration round, guiding users and summarizing outcomes concisely.
